sponsored.t: Requires mercantile establishments to cease collections under certain circumstances
sponsored.sum: Requires mercantile establishments to cease collections upon a court finding of not guilty of larceny in mercantile establishments.

sponsored.t: Requires all edible cannabis products be packaged in child resistant packaging
sponsored.sum: Prohibits all registered organizations, licensees, or permittees or other entities under the jurisdiction of the cannabis board from selling or delivering any edible cannabis products not in child resistant packaging.

sponsored.t: Directs the superintendent of financial services to conduct an analysis of the financial stability of the check cashing industry and review the current system of licensing for such industry
sponsored.sum: Directs the superintendent of financial services to conduct an analysis of the financial stability of the check cashing industry and review the current system of licensing for such industry and issue reports on both topics.
sponsored.fis: None, it is anticipated that existing personnel can complete the mandated reports in this bill.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "sunshine in litigation act" regarding protective orders
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "sunshine in litigation act" regarding protective orders to prohibit settlement agreements which conceal a public hazard or any information that would identify a public hazard.

sponsored.t: Increases the value of a motor vehicle exempt from the provisions of a will or intestate distribution for the benefit of the family of a decedent
sponsored.sum: Increases the value of a motor vehicle exempt from the provisions of a will or intestate distribution for the benefit of the family of a decedent.
sponsored.fis: The increased dollar amount for an automobile which could be set off to a spouse and children may result in decreased in filings of administra- tive petitions and commensurate reduction in the time of court personnel to review such filings. The loss of filing fees which might have been received will be offset by the savings of time for court personnel.

sponsored.t: Requires entities that submit records to state agencies that are excepted from disclosure under FOIL to periodically re-apply for the exception
sponsored.sum: Requires entities that submit records to state agencies that are excepted from disclosure under FOIL to periodically re-apply for the exception.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring disclosure of use of generative artificial intelligence in a civil action
sponsored.sum: Requires certification of filings produced using generative artificial intelligence; requires the brief of an appellant to contain a disclosure of the use of generative artificial intelligence in the drafting of the brief and certification that the content therein was reviewed and verified by a human.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting pre-payment penalties for mortgages secured by real property owned in a cooperative form of ownership
sponsored.sum: Prohibits pre-payment penalties for mortgages secured by real property owned in a cooperative form of ownership where over fifty percent of the units are shareholder occupied.

sponsored.t: Enacts "Shavon's law" prohibiting enforcement of a lien where an occupant has a pending social services department storage fee assistance request or appeal
sponsored.sum: Enacts "Shavon's law" prohibiting enforcement of a lien where an occupant has a pending social services department storage fee assistance request or appeal; provides the necessary steps for ensuring such enforcement is paused.

sponsored.t: Relates to the duration of mechanic's liens
sponsored.sum: Provides for the continuation of a mechanic's lien which has been discharged by undertaking for a period of three years from the commencement of a foreclosure action.

sponsored.t: Expands how applicants may qualify for a license to be a dentist
sponsored.sum: Expands how applicants may qualify for a license to be a dentist to include postdoctoral specialty programs and advanced education programs in general dentistry.

sponsored.t: Relates to remedies for unlawful discharge or discrimination for the exercise of an employee's right to be absent from employment for jury duty
sponsored.sum: Creates, in addition to the existing sanction of criminal contempt of court, the remedies of labor law civil penalties and employee's right to bring civil action for unlawful discharge, penalty or discrimination on account of the exercise by an employee of a juror's right to be absent from employment by reason of jury service.

sponsored.t: Permits an eligible retirement system member to receive, in lieu of an ordinary death benefit, a death benefit such member would otherwise be entitled to receive
sponsored.sum: Permits an eligible retirement system member to receive, in lieu of an ordinary death benefit, a death benefit such member would otherwise be entitled to receive provided such member is a state-paid judge or justice of the unified court system or a housing judge of the civil court of the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Allows certain minor defendants to utilize electronic appearances
sponsored.sum: Allows certain minor defendants under the age of 18 to utilize electronic appearances under certain circumstances.

sponsored.t: Requires the advice and consent of the city council for the appointment of judges by the Mayor of the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Requires the advice and consent of the city council when the New York City mayor is appointing judges for family court and city-wide criminal courts.

sponsored.t: Relates to electronic filing for the court of appeals
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the court of appeals to promulgate rules authorizing the use of electronic means for civil and criminal matters in such court.

sponsored.t: Provides additional protection to judges and their family members under the Judicial Security Act
sponsored.sum: Provides additional protection to judges and their family members under the Judicial Security Act; expands protection to domestic partners and adult children; relates to records to be kept private; relates to the continuation of the prohibition against the public disclosure of personal information; authorizes the chief administrator of the courts to develop procedures necessary to prevent the disclosure of personal information in the possession of the unified court system.

sponsored.t: Provides qualified homeless individuals non-driver state identification cards
sponsored.sum: Provides qualified homeless individuals non-driver state identification cards if there is proof provided that such individual is in fact homeless.

sponsored.t: Relates to making technical corrections to ensure gender neutrality for the admission to practice law and preventing required disclosure of prior interaction with law enforcement or the criminal justice system
sponsored.sum: Relates to making technical corrections to ensure gender neutrality for the admission to practice law and preventing the character fitness questionnaire from inquiring into an applicant's prior interaction with law enforcement or the criminal justice system under certain circumstances.

sponsored.t: Relates to audio-visual coverage of judicial proceedings by the media; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to audio-visual coverage of judicial proceedings by the media; allows the judge or justice presiding over a proceeding to exercise discretion to prohibit or limit filming or photographing of particular participants; defines terms; provides limitations on audio-visual coverage.

sponsored.t: Relates to actions and proceedings seeking an abatement of rent based on violations of the housing maintenance code
sponsored.ls: New York City Civil Court Act
sponsored.sum: Relates to actions and proceedings seeking an abatement of rent based on violations of the housing maintenance code, applicable housing standards, the building code, or the health code; relates to the number of housing judges assigned to certain actions.

sponsored.t: Relates to arbitration proceedings
sponsored.sum: Amends provisions of law governing arbitration proceedings; specifies fees and expenses with regard to employment or consumer arbitration proceedings; directs certain sanctions on a party which breaches an arbitration agreement.

sponsored.t: Relates to failure to complete a program for time allowances due to circumstances beyond an individual's control
sponsored.sum: Relates to failure to complete a program for time allowances due to circumstances beyond an individual's control.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of education to change the name of the state high school equivalency diploma to the Excelsior diploma
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of education to change the name of the state high school equivalency diploma, formerly known as the general education development (GED) program, to the Excelsior diploma.

sponsored.t: Relates to obtaining jurisdiction over certain defendants in matters relating to a tenancy or lease
sponsored.sum: Standardizes the language across the relevant court acts to allow tenants statewide to sue in the county where the real property at issue is located in matters relating to a tenancy or lease; requires the Office of Court Administration to develop necessary forms, procedures and deliver a report.

sponsored.t: Repeals section 470 of the judiciary law relating to allowing attorneys having offices in the state to reside in an adjoining state
sponsored.sum: Repeals provisions relating to allowing attorneys having offices in the state to reside in an adjoining state.

sponsored.t: Prevents a judge from prohibiting a parent from undergoing a gender reassignment when making a determination in a child custody case
sponsored.sum: Provides that the judge shall not prohibit a parent from undergoing gender reassignment.

sponsored.t: Relates to referrals for child support enforcement for foster care maintenance payments
sponsored.sum: Relates to liability to support a child who is placed in foster care pursuant to an approved application for foster care maintenance; provides that such liability shall not be imposed if it will adversely affect the health, safety or welfare of the child on whose behalf such payments are to be made or other persons in the child's household or will adversely affect the length of the child's placement or impair the ability of the child to return home when discharged from foster care; limits the ability of a county or local social services district to cause a referral to be sent for the purpose of commencing collection of child support for a child placed in foster care.

sponsored.t: Relates to liability of cities and counties for negligence in the placement of a child
sponsored.sum: Relates to the duty owed by cities and counties to children in the legal custody of such cities and counties with respect to the placement of children; provides a statutory private right of action for compensatory damage.

sponsored.t: Clarifies what qualifies as the unlawful practice of law
sponsored.sum: Clarifies what qualifies as the unlawful practice of law; makes technical changes as to unlawful advertising in procuring a divorce.

sponsored.t: Relates to proper procedures for remote depositions
sponsored.sum: Relates to proper procedures for remote depositions including location, and the administration of the oath.

sponsored.t: Clarifies the need for expedited relief when seeking an order to show cause
sponsored.sum: Clarifies the need for expedited relief when seeking an order to show cause; provides the application shall require why such relief is necessary.

sponsored.t: Designates how certain parties may be named in a lawsuit; repealer
sponsored.sum: Designates how certain parties may be named in a lawsuit; repeals certain provisions on the substitution of parties.

sponsored.t: Relates to notice period for eviction from a manufactured home park
sponsored.sum: Provides that a warrant for eviction from a manufactured home park shall give fourteen days notice, if such person rents a manufactured home in a manufactured home park from a manufactured home park owner or operator.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing the salaries of judges
sponsored.sum: Relates to increasing the salaries of judges, justices, administrators of the courts and administrative judges in various courts.

sponsored.t: Exempts student interns from the two-year lobbying prohibition
sponsored.sum: Exempts student interns from the two-year lobbying prohibition placed on legislative employees.

sponsored.t: Requires the Department of Homeless Services to notify the affected community board prior to locating transitional housing for the homeless
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring the Department of Homeless Services to notify the affected community board prior to locating transitional housing for the homeless; requires written notification sixty days before the department enters into a contractual arrangement with a transitional housing provider or otherwise finalizes its decision to use or expand a location as transitional housing.

sponsored.t: Requires the New York city department of corrections and the New York city health and hospitals corporation to adopt safety policies to protect health care workers who treat incarcerated individuals
sponsored.sum: Requires the New York city department of corrections and the New York city health and hospitals corporation to adopt safety policies to protect health care workers who treat incarcerated individuals.

sponsored.t: Relates to the number of surrogate's court judges in Bronx County
sponsored.sum: Changes the number of surrogate's court judges in Bronx County to two.

sponsored.t: Requires adjournment information to be posted on the New York state courts electronic filing website
sponsored.sum: Requires adjournment information to be posted on the New York state courts electronic filing website.

sponsored.t: Requires a detailed determination in orders determining a motion
sponsored.sum: Requires a detailed determination in orders determining a motion, no longer up to a judge's discretion.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing for vacation of an arbitration award on the ground that the arbitrator was affiliated with a party, or has a financial interest in a party or the outcome
sponsored.sum: Requires disclosure of possible conflicts of an arbitrator; provides for the vacating of an arbitration award on the ground that the arbitrator was affiliated in any way with any party, or has a financial interest directly or indirectly in any party or in the outcome of the arbitration.

sponsored.t: Establishes visiting policies for incarcerated individuals
sponsored.sum: Establishes visiting policies for incarcerated people, to provide incarcerated people opportunities for personal contact with relatives, friends, clergy, volunteers and other persons to promote better institutional adjustment and better community adjustment upon release.

sponsored.t: Relates to housing courts
sponsored.ls: New York City Civil Court Act
sponsored.sum: Provides that in the city of New York, a part of the court shall be devoted to actions and proceedings where: every party to the proceeding is a natural person; or the petitioner alleges in its petition that it is a "small landlord"; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a process for neutral arbitrators to review certain disciplinary decisions and penalties imposed on members of the New York city police department
sponsored.sum: Establishes a process for neutral arbitrators to review certain disciplinary decisions and penalties imposed on members of the New York city police department.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Big Five African Trophies Act" relating to banning the importation, transportation and possession of certain African wildlife species and products
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Big Five African Trophies Act" relating to banning the importation, transportation and possession of certain African wildlife species and products.

sponsored.t: Prohibits using possession of reproductive or sexual health devices as evidence in a trial, hearing or proceeding in certain circumstances
sponsored.sum: Provides that possession of a condom or other reproductive or sexual health device may not be received in evidence in any trial, hearing or proceeding as evidence of conduct which would constitute an offense defined in article 230 of the penal law.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a public transportation expansion fund
sponsored.sum: Establishes a public transportation expansion fund for the purpose of ensuring access to public transportation for publicly funded economic development projects.

sponsored.t: Relates to alternate jurors
sponsored.sum: Provides that after an alternate juror has been substituted, the jury shall deliberate anew on all issues submitted to the jury at the outset of deliberations; exempts issues for which a verdict was already rendered.

sponsored.t: Relates to permitting amendment of a claim or notice of intention to file a claim to correct jurisdictional pleading defects
sponsored.sum: Permits amendment of a claim or notice of intention to file a claim to correct jurisdictional pleading defects and the dismissal of a claim based upon claimant's failure to comply with jurisdictional pleading requirements.

sponsored.t: Modernizes, improves fairness, efficiency, transparency, and reduces costs in civil justice procedures; repealer
sponsored.sum: Modernizes, improves fairness, efficiency, transparency, and reduces costs in civil justice procedures; clarifies disclosure and discovery procedures to further protect litigants' rights.
sponsored.fis: Minimal direct cost to the State. Potential long-term savings through reduced motion practice, lower litigation costs, and more efficient court administration.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "New York state right to counsel act"
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Establishes a fundamental right to counsel for all respondents facing eviction proceedings; mandates an automatic stay or adjournment on any housing court eviction proceedings if a tenant does not have an attorney.

sponsored.t: Requires any website or mobile application associated with an electronic benefit transfer system to be offered in the twelve most common non-English languages
sponsored.sum: Requires any website or mobile application associated with an electronic benefit transfer system to be offered in the twelve most common non-English languages spoken by limited-English proficient individuals in the state, based on data in the most recent American Community Survey published by the United States Census Bureau.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing language access services to individuals relating to certain tax abatement programs
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing language access services to individuals relating to the tax abatement program for rent-controlled and rent-regulated property occupied by senior citizens or persons with disabilities and senior citizen and disabled homeowners.

sponsored.t: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions of the coordinated construction act for lower Manhattan and certain other provisions relating to joint bidding on contracts for public work projects
sponsored.sum: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions of the coordinated construction act for lower Manhattan and certain other provisions relating to joint bidding on contracts for public work projects.

sponsored.t: Establishes civil liability for the deprivation of any rights, privileges, or immunities secured by the federal or state constitution
sponsored.sum: Provides that every person who, under color of any statute, ordinance, regulation, custom, or usage, of the United States, subjects or causes to be subjected any citizen of New York or other person within the jurisdiction thereof to the deprivation of any rights, privileges, or immunities secured by the federal or state constitution shall be liable to the injured party in an action at law, suit in equity, or other proper proceeding.

sponsored.t: Relates to consideration of gender-affirming health care or gender-affirming mental health care in child custody cases
sponsored.sum: Relates to consideration of gender-affirming health care or gender-affirming mental health care in child custody cases for purposes of jurisdiction, forum and enforcement of custody orders.

sponsored.t: Relates to proof of claims for unjust conviction and imprisonment
sponsored.sum: Relates to proof of claims for unjust conviction and imprisonment.

sponsored.t: Relates to the liability of electronic marketplaces for compensation for damages for defective goods
sponsored.sum: Provides that an electronic marketplace provider shall be deemed to be a retailer for purposes of New York strict liability law and shall be strictly liable for all damages caused by defective products placed into the stream of commerce to the same extent that a retailer of that defective product would be liable.

sponsored.t: Requires annual reports of legal settlement payments related to law enforcement activity
sponsored.sum: Requires annual reports of legal settlement payments related to law enforcement activity; provides such report shall include, but not be limited to, monetary amounts, plaintiffs and named parties, and shall be published on the website of the comptroller.

sponsored.t: Relates to limiting recordkeeping and reporting duties of public notaries
sponsored.sum: Limits recordkeeping and reporting duties of public notaries to electronic notarization acts.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing notice to elected officials upon receipt of an application for a liquor license
sponsored.sum: Requires the state liquor authority to provide notice to state legislative representatives upon receipt of an application for a liquor license in their district.

sponsored.t: Requires every general hospital to have a community advisory board
sponsored.sum: Requires every general hospital to have a community advisory board.
sponsored.fis: Minimal. Community advisory board members would not be paid but may be reimbursed by the hospital for their expenses.

sponsored.t: Provides for absence from school for the mental or behavioral health of the minor
sponsored.sum: Provides for absence from school for the mental or behavioral health of the minor.

sponsored.t: Removes statute of limitations for certain civil actions related to child sexual assault offenses
sponsored.sum: Removes statute of limitations for certain civil actions related to child sexual assault offenses.

sponsored.t: Relates to expanding the persons responsible for reporting cases of suspected child abuse
sponsored.sum: Relates to expanding the persons responsible for reporting cases of suspected child abuse to include employees, volunteers, or agents of any corporate entity having an agreement with a municipality as a tier II facility or any other shelter providing temporary housing to persons under the age of 18.

sponsored.t: Prohibits discrimination on the basis of a person's height or weight in opportunities of employment, housing, and access to public accommodations
sponsored.sum: Prohibits discrimination on the basis of a person's height or weight in opportunities of employment, housing, and access to public accommodations.

sponsored.t: Requires motorcycles to be registered at point of sale
sponsored.sum: Requires motorcycles to be registered at point of sale.

sponsored.t: Relates to the establishment of a single computerized state DNA identification index and requires municipalities to expunge any DNA record stored in a municipal DNA identification index
sponsored.sum: Relates to the establishment of a single computerized state DNA identification index; requires municipalities to expunge any DNA record stored in a municipal DNA identification index.

sponsored.t: Repeals provision of county law relating to access to records of calls made to a municipality's E911 system
sponsored.sum: Relates to access to records of calls made to a municipality's E911 system.

sponsored.t: Relates to actions for illegal and improper practices of commercial towing companies
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a lien against personal and real property of the owner of a commercial towing company for illegal and improper practices; creates personal liability for members of an LLC and certain corporate shareholders.

sponsored.t: Requires employment and consumer dispute arbitrations to be submitted to neutral third party arbitrators, and establishes prohibited arbitration agreements and provisions
sponsored.sum: Requires employment and consumer dispute arbitrations to be submitted to neutral third party arbitrators; establishes prohibited arbitration agreements and provisions; requires disclosure of information by certain arbitrators.

sponsored.t: Relates to the right of defendants in misdemeanor or felony cases to have such matter appear before a judge or justice admitted to practice law in New York
sponsored.sum: Relates to the right of defendants in misdemeanor or felony cases to have such matter appear before a judge or justice admitted to practice law in New York; creates an automatic right to have a case reassigned to an attorney judge.

sponsored.t: Creates a subpart of the housing part to handle cases involving condominiums and cooperative buildings
sponsored.ls: New York City Civil Court Act
sponsored.sum: Creates a special subpart of the housing part within the NYC civil court to handle cases involving condominiums and cooperative buildings.
sponsored.fis: Negligible. A separate part in Housing Court could be implemented with- out increasing the number of judges in the space currently devoted to Housing Court. The modest administrative cost of establishing this program and screening incoming cases so as to direct those involving cooperatives and condominiums to the new part will be quickly offset by the time and money saved in expedited resolution of cases. Judges versed in the relationships between the board and residents in these resident- owned and governed buildings will be able to hand down decisions that interpret the law consistently and clearly. This should also lead to an additional benefit in the form of fewer appeals, which would even further reduce the burden on the courts.

sponsored.t: Relates to limiting the use of a victim's DNA collected from sexual offense evidence kits
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of a victim's DNA collected from sexual offense evidence kits from being added to the state DNA identification index or other databases or being used in certain actions.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring certain child passengers in a taxi or livery to be restrained by a child restraint system
sponsored.sum: Requires that no person under four years of age shall be a passenger in a taxi or livery unless such person is restrained by a child restraint system; requires that no person four years of age or older but under age eight shall be a passenger in a taxi or livery unless such person is restrained in an appropriate child restraint system; establishes violations of such provisions shall be punished by a civil fine of up to fifty dollars.

sponsored.t: Allows voters to take photographs of themselves and their ballot, or absentee ballot, while in a privacy booth, and to share and disseminate such photographs on social media
sponsored.sum: Allows voters to take photographs of themselves and their ballot, or absentee ballot, while in a privacy booth, and to share and disseminate such photographs on social media.

sponsored.t: Exempts amounts received from any financial settlement for childhood sexual abuse for determining eligibility for or amount of benefits
sponsored.sum: Exempts amounts received from any financial settlement for childhood sexual abuse for determining eligibility for or amount of benefits under any program provided under the social security law.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting discrimination against a person based upon weight
sponsored.sum: Relates to prohibiting discrimination against a person based upon weight; excepts where deviation may pose a threat to the individual, other patrons, or the general public.

sponsored.t: Increases the penalties for leaving the scene of an accident involving an electric scooter without reporting in the first and second degrees
sponsored.sum: Increases the penalties for leaving the scene of an accident involving an electric scooter without reporting in the first and second degrees; creates the offenses of leaving the scene of an accident involving a bicycle with electric assist without reporting in the first and second degrees.

sponsored.t: Relates to the civil jurisdiction of county and district courts
sponsored.sum: Expands the civil jurisdiction of county courts to matters of up to fifty thousand dollars and district courts to matters of up to thirty-five thousand dollars.

sponsored.t: Allowing certain payments from the IOLA fund to be made without appropriation by law
sponsored.sum: Allows certain payments from the New York interest on lawyer account fund to be made without appropriation by law.

sponsored.t: Enacts the stop highway community harm act
sponsored.sum: Prevents an increase in vehicular lane capacity of highways within two hundred feet of certain public housing facilities, in areas with high rates of asthma, and in environmental justice communities.

sponsored.t: Establishes open enrollment schools
sponsored.sum: Establishes open enrollment schools; provides that nonresidents of a district, if otherwise eligible to enroll into a public school of this state are entitled to enroll into the school or schools of another district or city if the nonresident district's board of education has adopted an open enrollment policy and enrolling the nonresident pupil is consistent with such policy.

sponsored.t: Prohibits parties to mediation or dispute resolution from recording such proceedings without the consent of all parties
sponsored.sum: Establishes an all-party consent requirement for any audio or video recording of mediation and court-annexed alternative dispute resolution proceedings.

sponsored.t: Replaces the terms father, mother, and filiation to gender neutral language; repealer
sponsored.sum: Replaces the terms father, mother, and filiation to gender neutral language.

sponsored.t: Requires motor vehicle rental companies to provide consumers with all associated fees at the time of rental
sponsored.sum: Requires motor vehicle rental companies to provide consumers with all associated fees at the time of rental including mandatory fees and extra costs.

sponsored.t: Creates the residential condominium owner bill of rights
sponsored.sum: Creates a residential condominium owner's bill of rights that includes the right to transparency, the right to timely decisions, voting rights, the right to notice, and the right against extraordinary expenses.

sponsored.t: Relates to filing in surrogate's court
sponsored.sum: Provides that a surrogate court clerk or chief clerk shall refuse to accept for filing papers filed in a proceeding only under certain circumstances or as designated in statute, administrative rule or order of the court; provides such reasons; requires the payment of any applicable statutory fees, or an order of the court waiving payment of such fees, before accepting a paper for filing; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to the proper form of exhibits for submission
sponsored.sum: Relates to the proper form of exhibits for submission; provides every exhibit shall be clearly identified, but no specific method of labeling shall be required.

sponsored.t: Relates to imposing an excise tax on firearms and ammunition
sponsored.sum: Imposes an excise tax on the gross receipts of the sales of firearms, major components of firearms and ammunition; establishes the gun violence prevention and school safety fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to available transportation for correction facility visitation
sponsored.sum: Relates to available transportation for correction facility visitation; provides for at a minimum, bimonthly free transportation from the city of New York, Rochester, Syracuse, Buffalo and Albany.

sponsored.t: Relates to the resentencing of certain juvenile and adolescent offenders
sponsored.sum: Relates to the resentencing of certain juvenile and adolescent offenders who were convicted prior to October 1, 2018 for offenses not including, rape, sexual assault, murder in the first degree or aggravated murder.

sponsored.t: Prohibits charging a fee to obtain a certified copy or certified transcript of birth in certain situations
sponsored.sum: Prohibits charging a fee to obtain a certified copy or certified transcript of birth when the department of corrections and community supervision or a local correctional facility requests such for an individual under community supervision in connection with such individual's ongoing supervision in the community.
sponsored.fis: Minimal to state and local governments.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "take the wheel act" which requires a driver be present in all motor vehicles operated for hire
sponsored.sum: Requires a driver be present in all motor vehicles operated for hire, seated behind the steering wheel and engaged in the task of driving.

sponsored.t: Exempts senior citizens from jury duty
sponsored.sum: Exempts from jury duty prospective jurors who are age seventy-five or older who make a request to be exempt.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "anti-slumlord act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "anti-slumlord act" which prohibits the acquisition of residential property by property owners with outstanding immediate hazardous violations; defines terms; establishes and requires a compliance certification form; sets forth recording requirements; provides for enforcement of provisions by the attorney general.

sponsored.t: Establishes Nicole's law, which provides for treatment of individuals with self-inflicted, life-threatening injuries
sponsored.sum: Establishes Nicole's law, which provides for intake and discharge procedures regarding individuals with self-inflicted, life-threatening injuries.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of psychotropic medications in nursing homes and adult care facilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to the use of antipsychotic medications in nursing homes; imposes limits as to time and documentation; requires informed consent under certain circumstances.

sponsored.t: Establishes a commission to study authorizing New York state-funded health services for eligible seniors and individuals with disabilities residing part-time in the Dominican Republic
sponsored.sum: Enacts the New York-Dominican health partnership act; establishes a commission to study and develop a framework for authorizing New York state-funded health services for eligible seniors and individuals with disabilities residing part-time in the Dominican Republic through a pilot partnership with the Seguro Nacional de Salud (SeNaSa), the primary public health insurer of the Dominican Republic and explores overall bilateral health collaboration between the state of New York and the Dominican Republic.
sponsored.fis: Minimal administrative cost for Commission operation; potential long- term Medicaid savings if pilot programs are authorized.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting provisions for the execution of electronic wills
sponsored.sum: Enacts provisions for the execution of electronic wills including attestation, revocation, filing and storage; requires the chief administrator of the courts to adopt rules necessary and appropriate for electronic wills.

sponsored.t: Relates to persons who may become a voluntary administrator
sponsored.sum: Relates to persons who may become a voluntary administrator; includes fiduciaries of a deceased distributee, or a competent adult who is not a distributee upon the filed consent of all competent distributees as persons who can become a voluntary administrator prior to the chief fiscal officer of the county becoming such.

sponsored.t: Prohibits self-service facility owners from enforcing liens on personal property held in a self-storage facility during state disaster emergencies or states of emergency
sponsored.sum: Prohibits self-service facility owners from enforcing liens, by private or public sale, on personal property held in a self-storage facility during state disaster emergencies or county states of emergency.

sponsored.t: Relates to defining a victim of a sexual offense
sponsored.sum: Adds to the definition of a victim of a sexual offense by including a victim of unlawful dissemination or publication of an intimate image.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing new fee rates for large estates
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing new fee rates for large estates; raises the fee rate for estates with a value over $5,000,000 to $10,000.
sponsored.fis: : Increased revenue for surrogate courts through new higher fee brackets in the fee schedule.

sponsored.t: Establishes a grant program to promote the mental health and wellness of teachers and staff in public schools
sponsored.sum: Establishes a program to promote the mental health and wellness of teachers and staff in public schools through grants.

sponsored.t: Prohibits utilities from charging customers excise tax
sponsored.sum: Prohibits utilities from charging customers excise tax; provides such tax shall be charged against and paid by the utility.

sponsored.t: Prohibits gambling on elections
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Provides that gambling upon the results of any political election shall be prohibited.

sponsored.t: Removes minimum year requirements for attendance at a New York high school when determining eligibility for certain student loans
sponsored.sum: Removes two year minimum attendance requirement at a New York high school when determining eligibility for certain student loans.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the "New York emergency expedited temporary work permit act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "New York emergency expedited temporary work permit act" to allow asylum seekers to apply for and be granted temporary work permits while their federal immigration status is being determined.
sponsored.fis: There is a minimal fiscal impact due to the administrative costs of implementing a worker permit program. The exact amount is yet to be determined, but it is expected to be minimal and will offset by the taxes paid by payroll taxes.

sponsored.t: Relates to applications for licenses to sell liquor and wine at grocery stores
sponsored.sum: Relates to applications for licenses to sell liquor and wine at grocery stores and off-premises consumption of liquors and/or wines at grocery stores.

sponsored.t: Relates to penalties for failure of an operator to return shared electric scooters and bicycles to a proper location
sponsored.sum: Requires entities which operate a system of shared electric bicycles or scooters to impose penalties for failure of an operator or borrower to return a shared electric scooter or bicycle to a proper location.

sponsored.t: Requires additional reporting and documentation requirements for manifestation determination reviews
sponsored.sum: Requires school districts to collect and annually report to the department of education certain information regarding manifestation determination reviews (MDRs) conducted during the prior school year; requires certain disaggregated information to be publicly reported regarding MDRs.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of education to study and report on the self-identified ethnicity and multilingual status of all licensed social workers
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of education to study and report on the self-identified ethnicity and multilingual status of all licensed social workers and provide such report to the governor and legislature no later than one year after the effective date of this act.

sponsored.t: Relates to defining community significant projects and including such projects in the excelsior jobs program
sponsored.sum: Defines community significant projects as a business creating or retaining current jobs as determined by the commissioner, with particular emphasis on employment and/or training of current public housing residents; currently located or to be located in existing leased space of a building in a public housing development in the state; and which makes significant qualified capital investments to start a business, or improve services and working conditions for an existing business, when located in such public housing space and including such projects in the excelsior jobs program.

sponsored.t: Includes wildlife animals as those subject to the animal cruelty provisions
sponsored.sum: Includes wildlife animals as those subject to the animal cruelty provisions of the agriculture and markets law.

sponsored.t: Requires the parole board to grant parole to incarcerated individuals who successfully participate in a temporary release program without interruption immediately prior to appearance before the board
sponsored.sum: Requires the parole board to grant parole to incarcerated individuals who successfully participate in a temporary release program for two years without interruption immediately prior to appearance before the board.
sponsored.fis: Will save money by providing a step down from incarceration to parole for individuals on work release.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring state and local law enforcement officers to identify themselves to the public
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring state and local law enforcement officers to identify themselves to the public during law enforcement activities.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing minimum rules for the treatment of incarcerated individuals
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing minimum rules for the treatment of incarcerated individuals; provides that the United Nations standard minimum rules for the treatment of prisoners, also known as the Nelson Mandela rules, are hereby incorporated by reference.

sponsored.t: Relates to incarcerated individuals wages
sponsored.sum: Relates to incarcerated individuals wages; provides that incarcerated individuals shall be compensated at a base rate of $1.20 to $10 per day and shall be given biannual raises for adequate performance; provides that incarcerated individuals not participating in a work or program assignment due to age or frailty shall be paid $1.00 per day, adjusted every 5 years for cost of living.

sponsored.t: Relates to appeals of parole determination
sponsored.sum: Relates to appeals of parole determination, including parole release interviews, parole decisions by the board and petitions regarding release decisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to assistance for burial arrangements
sponsored.sum: Expands the maximum benefit and eligibility requirements for financial assistance for burial arrangements; provides for expedited assistance during a state disaster emergency.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of social services to establish a centralized homelessness crisis response data system
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of social services to establish a centralized homelessness crisis response data system through which state agencies, local governmental entities, including law enforcement agencies, court systems, school districts, and emergency service providers, and other relevant persons are able to share and access information related to individuals who experience chronic homelessness in order to connect or refer such individuals to services including affordable housing opportunities.

sponsored.t: Prohibits consumer reporting agencies from requiring or requesting certain consumer information
sponsored.sum: Relates to prohibiting consumer reporting agencies from requiring or requesting a copy of a consumer's social security card when furnishing consumer reports or investigative consumer reports to third parties.

sponsored.t: Requires school districts to establish a language assistance program for limited English proficient parents of students
sponsored.sum: Requires school districts to establish a language assistance program for limited English proficient parents of students; requires record keeping and annual reporting; permits districts to jointly establish such programs.

sponsored.t: Relates to the automatic expungement of records of arrest
sponsored.sum: Provides for the automatic expungement of records of arrest in certain situations.

sponsored.t: Relates to the removal of incarcerated individuals diagnosed with mental illness to a residential mental health treatment unit
sponsored.sum: Relates to the removal of incarcerated individuals diagnosed with mental illness to a residential mental health treatment unit.
sponsored.fis: Unknown but appropriate mental health treatment should save the state money in the long run. Additionally, there are currently vacant beds in the treatment units, and with the settlement in Peoples v. Fischer, fewer inmates should have long SHU sanctions, freeing up more treatment beds.

sponsored.t: Relates to notification and hearings for proposed construction or removal of bicycle lanes or racks
sponsored.sum: Relates to notification and hearings for proposed construction or removal of bicycle lanes or racks; requires a presentation at a public hearing when the department of transportation proposes to construct or remove a bicycle lane or rack; defines terms.

sponsored.t: Requires police officers to report the misconduct of a police officer
sponsored.sum: Requires police officers to report the misconduct of a police officer; requires the division of criminal justice to establish a protocol to be followed by police agencies when handling and recording mandatory reports of misconduct by a police officer; establishes the crime of failure to report misconduct by a police officer.

sponsored.t: Requires persistently dangerous schools to file an incident reduction plan detailing the steps the school will take to reduce incidents of violence and disruption
sponsored.sum: Requires persistently dangerous schools to file an incident reduction plan detailing the steps the school will take to reduce incidents of violence and disruption; requires notice to be given to victims of harassment, bullying, or violent offenses of their right to transfer to another public school.

sponsored.t: Establishes residential treatment facilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing residential treatment facilities as an alternative to incarceration designated by the commissioner for the care and treatment of persons with serious mental illness who are accused of at least one felony level crime.
sponsored.fis: None. It will save the state money.

sponsored.t: Relates to the public release of grand jury documents
sponsored.sum: Relates to the public release of grand jury documents; releases the district attorney's grand jury charges to the public upon request once the grand jury has reached a final decision.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating the Puerto Rican relief account
sponsored.sum: Relates to creating the Puerto Rican relief account which shall consist of all recovery and relief funds provided by the federal government to the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico under the Bipartisan Budget Act of 2018.

sponsored.t: Relates to the housing of transgender or intersex incarcerated individuals
sponsored.sum: Relates to the housing of transgender or intersex incarcerated individuals; authorizes the sheriff to assign a transgender or intersex incarcerated individual to any facility housing unit which shall ensure the incarcerated individual's health and safety.
sponsored.fis: As proposed, the bill will allow local correctional facilities to comply with the transgender and intersex inmate classification requirements of the Prison Rape Elimination Act (PREA) and therefore receive full feder- al funding.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the acceptance of a waiver of probate form by transfer agents
sponsored.sum: Prohibits transfer agents from accepting waiver of probate forms to bypass formal estate procedures through the courts.

sponsored.t: Relates to guidance to facilities and programs overseen by state agencies on interactions with federal immigration authorities
sponsored.sum: Relates to guidance to facilities and programs overseen by state agencies on interactions with Federal immigration authorities.

sponsored.t: Qualifies when kidnapping or related offenses constitute a sex offense
sponsored.sum: Qualifies when kidnapping or related offenses that are committed in furtherance of a sex crime will be considered a sex offense.

sponsored.t: Relates to law enforcement agencies reporting sex offender changes of address to the division of criminal justice services
sponsored.sum: Requires law enforcement agencies to report sex offender changes of address within five business days to the division of criminal justice services.

sponsored.t: Establishes a temporary state commission to study and make recommendations on violence in state correctional facilities
sponsored.sum: Establishes a temporary state commission to study and make recommendations on violence in state correctional facilities including the causes and consequences of such violence with a particular emphasis on changes in levels of violence and the causes of those changes.

sponsored.t: Relates to the termination of law enforcement officer benefits for malfeasance or serious misconduct
sponsored.sum: Provides that any officer terminated who was dismissed for malfeasance or serious misconduct or resigned or retired during an investigation relating to such malfeasance or serious misconduct shall not be entitled to receive any retirement or other benefit or payment of any kind.
sponsored.fis: None. This proposal has the ability to save the state money.

sponsored.t: Prohibits elementary and secondary schools from withholding student transcripts for failure to pay tuition
sponsored.sum: Prohibits elementary and secondary schools from withholding student transcripts for failure to pay tuition.
sponsored.fis: None to the state of New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to parole eligibility for felony offenders; repealer
sponsored.sum: Requires that all felony offenders shall be eligible for parole after serving no more than twenty-five years of their sentence; eliminates the possibility of serving consecutive terms of imprisonment which exceed a twenty-five year sentence.

sponsored.t: Relates to communications by mercantile establishments attempting to settle civil actions deriving from larceny prosecutions
sponsored.sum: Requires certain notices in communications by mercantile establishments attempting to settle civil actions deriving from larceny prosecutions.

sponsored.t: Relates to mandatory continuing education for teachers relating to mental health issues
sponsored.sum: Relates to mandatory continuing education for teachers relating to mental health issues.

sponsored.t: Authorizes emergency medical care personnel to provide basic first aid to dogs and cats
sponsored.sum: Authorizes emergency medical care personnel to provide basic first aid to dogs and cats.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring the inclusion of suicide prevention resources be provided with a warrant of eviction
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Requires the inclusion of suicide prevention resources to be provided with a warrant of eviction, including the National Suicide Prevention Lifeline and the applicable Suicide Crisis telephone number as provided by the Office of Mental Health.

sponsored.t: Relates to project labor agreement feasibility studies and apprenticeship agreements
sponsored.sum: Relates to project labor agreement feasibility studies and apprenticeship agreements; provides the study shall look to see if there will be a negative impact on opportunities for minority, women or service-disabled veteran owned businesses; provides such feasibility studies shall be provided to the public for review and comment.

sponsored.t: Permits emergency medical parole during a time of crisis
sponsored.sum: Permits emergency medical parole during a time of crisis to those that have a disability and who are at serious risk for death, disease or other harm due to an emergency disaster being declared provided such person has a reasonably stable living situation upon release and does not pose an unreasonable current public safety risk.
sponsored.fis: Will save the state money by lowering the prison population and lowering medical costs for incarcerated people.

sponsored.t: Relates to removing the fee for a sex offender to make a change to such sex offender's registration with the division of criminal justice services
sponsored.sum: Relates to removing the fee for a sex offender to make a change to such sex offender's registration with the division of criminal justice services including fees for changing their address, or any change to their status of enrollment, attendance, employment or residence at any institution of higher education.

sponsored.t: Relates to the state board of parole members
sponsored.sum: Relates to the state board of parole members; requires the board have at least nineteen members.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing emergency release protocols during a time of crisis
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing emergency release protocols during a time of crisis including during a state disaster emergency which places the lives, health or well-being of people in custody at risk.

sponsored.t: Establishes sex offender residency restrictions
sponsored.sum: Allows a district attorney to file a petition to seek the imposition of residency restrictions for certain sex offenders; allows a sex offender subject to a residency restriction to petition the court which imposed such restriction for an order terminating or modifying such residency restriction.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring certain employers to provide workforce demographics and equity measurements to the division of human rights annually
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring certain employers to provide workforce demographics and equity measurements to the division of human rights annually, including each employee's race, ethnicity, age, and sex or gender identity or expression, as well as the employee's job category, date of hire, salary or wages, training received, raises, promotions, disciplinary actions, terminations and benefits, including but not limited to unpaid benefits or privileges such as flexible scheduling, the ability to work from home, or the ability to bring children to work.

sponsored.t: Relates to protecting students, faculty, and staff from immigration enforcement while attending or participating in school activities
sponsored.sum: Prohibits immigration enforcement in school settings; prohibits all public and charter schools from allowing law enforcement officials inside school property to access a student, except to address an imminent safety situation or if they have an appropriate judicial warrant or judicial order.
sponsored.fis: Minimal administrative costs anticipated for compliance and reporting requirements.

sponsored.t: Relates to the "driver's license access and privacy act"
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the department of motor vehicles to issue standard drivers' licenses; restricts what information can be retained and given out on those applying or holding standard drivers' licenses.

sponsored.t: Ensures language assistance services by state agencies and requires state agencies to maintain records and to submit an annual report on language services
sponsored.sum: Ensures language assistance services by state agencies; requires state agencies to maintain records of the primary language spoken by any individual seeking such assistance; requires state agency to submit an annual report on language services.

sponsored.t: Creates the New York state commission on sex offender supervision and management
sponsored.sum: Creates the New York state commission on sex offender supervision and management; provides that such commission shall consist of thirteen members; requires the commission to make a report of its findings.

sponsored.t: Prohibits transportation network companies from including mandatory arbitration clauses in user agreements for certain offenses
sponsored.sum: Relates to prohibiting transportation network companies from including mandatory arbitration clauses in user agreements for certain offenses including assault and sex offenses; provides all user agreements issued with such clause shall be considered null and void and new agreements without such clause shall be issued within 14 days of the effective date of this legislation.

sponsored.t: Relates to the disposal of seized perishable or canned foods
sponsored.sum: Relates to the disposal of seized perishable or canned foods; provide such foods should not be disposed of but should be donated to a food relief organization or homeless shelter.

sponsored.t: Relates to schemes to defraud and establishing the crime of harassment of a legal services client; repealer
sponsored.sum: Restructures the crimes of schemes to defraud; establishes the crime of harassment of a legal services client.
sponsored.fis: Minimal administrative costs anticipated for enforcement and prose- cution.

sponsored.t: Creates a private right of action for the breach of a consumer's identifying information
sponsored.sum: Relates to creating a private right of action for the breach of a consumer's identifying information such as their social security number, driver's license number, bank account number, credit or debit card number, personal identification number, automated or electronic signature, unique biometric data, account passwords or other information that can be used to access an individual's financial accounts or to obtain goods and services.

sponsored.t: Relates to applying a special Medicaid rate for releasees in nursing homes
sponsored.sum: Relates to applying a special Medicaid rate for releasees in facilities or discrete units within facilities that provide long term nursing or medical services.

sponsored.t: Authorizes daily visitation at all general confinement correctional facilities
sponsored.sum: Authorizes visitation at all general confinement correctional facilities seven days a week.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the operation of establishments where animals and/or fowls are slaughtered or butchered for food
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the operation of establishments where animals and/or fowls are slaughtered or butchered for food; establishes a task force on public health risks and animal welfare concerns of slaughterhouses.

sponsored.t: Requires that all police officers and peace officers involved in the execution of a search warrant wear body cameras
sponsored.sum: Requires that each police officer and peace officer involved in the execution of a search warrant wear a functioning and unobstructed body camera that shall be active prior to and throughout the execution of the search and during any related action following the execution of the search warrant.

sponsored.t: Relates to the discharging of certain sentences
sponsored.sum: Relates to the discharging of certain sentences; makes all felonies eligible for discharge.
sponsored.fis: To be determined. Should lead to cost savings for the state.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring building condition surveys to be conducted on public school buildings constructed prior to 1950 every other year and a visual inspection in alternate years
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring building condition surveys to be conducted on public school buildings constructed prior to 1950 every other year and a visual inspection in alternate years.

sponsored.t: Relates to the registration status of voters
sponsored.sum: Relates to the registration status of voters; establishes additional requirements for the cancellation of a voter's registration; allows voters who have an inactive status to have their registration returned to active status and to have their vote counted for the election in which they vote.

sponsored.t: Allows photographs of one's self and one's own ballot while voting
sponsored.sum: Allows photographs of one's self and one's own ballot while voting.

sponsored.t: Relates to criminal mischief in the third degree and criminal mischief in the second degree
sponsored.sum: Relates to criminal mischief in the third degree and criminal mischief in the second degree.

sponsored.t: Prohibits disclosure of highway, bridge, tunnel and other thoroughfare toll and transit records, with exceptions
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the disclosure of highway, bridge, tunnel and other thoroughfare toll and transit records, with exceptions.

sponsored.t: Relates to discharge planning to assist incarcerated individuals in obtaining housing before release to community supervision
sponsored.sum: Relates to the department of correction and community supervision's role with respect to discharge planning to assist incarcerated individuals in obtaining housing before release to community supervision.

sponsored.t: Requires dialysis center disaster preparedness plans
sponsored.sum: Requires facilities offering dialysis services to have an alternate generated power source for use during a general power outage or disaster emergency; provides exemptions.
sponsored.fis: None for NYS. Will prevent worsening of chronic health conditions that will lead to more expensive and intensive medical care and even death.

sponsored.t: Establishes an optional retirement stipend for certain incarcerated individuals over sixty-two years of age
sponsored.sum: Establishes an optional retirement stipend of thirty dollars per month for incarcerated individuals over age sixty-two who have completed at least five years of their sentence.

sponsored.t: Changes the definition of the word "weed"
sponsored.sum: Changes the definition of the word "weed" to include certain types of plants and exclude those that are endangered or indigenous to this state.

sponsored.t: Relates to amending the term residential treatment facility; repealer
sponsored.sum: Amends the term residential treatment facility to remove "persons who are on parole or conditional release" from such term.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of a sexually violent offender and sex offense as applied to out-of-state offenders
sponsored.sum: Relates to the definition of a sexually violent offender and sex offense as applied to out-of-state offenders.

sponsored.t: Requires small businesses to have and maintain a first aid kit on the premises of the business at all times
sponsored.sum: Requires small businesses to have and maintain a first aid kit on the premises of the business at all times and to store such kits in an accessible location and to make such kits available for use by any person who enters the premises of the business.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a commission for the educational advancement of multilingual learners in New York
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing a commission for the educational advancement of multilingual learners in New York; provides such commission shall report on the best practices and legislative recommendations to close the achievement gap and high school graduation rates between multilingual learners and their English proficient peers from prekindergarten through twelfth grade.

sponsored.t: Relates to attorneys' fees in actions for unlawful discriminatory practices
sponsored.sum: Permits awarding of reasonable attorneys' fees and costs in court actions for unlawful discriminatory practices pursuant to the human rights law.

sponsored.t: Relates to reporting voting rates for parole commissioners
sponsored.sum: Requires that annual reports include the voting rates for parole commissioners for persons appearing before them for release.

sponsored.t: Requires TNC passengers to acknowledge certain legal notices
sponsored.sum: Requires TNC passengers, prior to using a digital network, to acknowledge a legal notice that states: "IF YOU CLICK HERE, YOU GIVE UP YOUR RIGHT TO SUE US IN COURT".

sponsored.t: Relates to the expiration and repeal of regulations limiting the engines of school vehicles to remain idling while parked or standing on school grounds
sponsored.sum: Relates to the expiration and repeal of regulations limiting the engines of school vehicles to remain idling while parked or standing on school grounds.

sponsored.t: Provides for the establishment of a forty-five dollar fee for all motions made in pending proceedings and for ex parte applications in the surrogate's court
sponsored.sum: Provides for the establishment of a forty-five dollar fee for all motions made in pending proceedings and for ex parte applications in the surrogate's court.
sponsored.fis: Significantly increased revenue for the surrogate's court through the mandatory implementation of this forty-five dollar fee.

sponsored.t: Relates to mercantile establishments and the defense of lawful detention
sponsored.sum: Relates to mercantile establishments and the defense of lawful detention; sets requirements that the release from detention shall not be conditioned on signing of any documents or agreements; provides if anything is signed a copy must be provided to the individual or their parent or guardian.

sponsored.t: Modifies the factors to be considered when making a parole release decision
sponsored.sum: Modifies the factors to be considered when making a parole release decision; updates the term "inmate" to "incarcerated person".
sponsored.fis: None. Will save the state money by letting some people out of prison sooner.

sponsored.t: Requires abandoned property escheat to the Indian nation or tribe that historically occupied the land or to nearest nation or tribe; repealer
sponsored.sum: Requires abandoned property escheat to the Indian nation or tribe that historically occupied the land or to the nearest nation or tribe; establishes such land shall be tribal land.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of corrections and community supervision to create a family reunion program
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of corrections and community supervision to create a family reunion program to provide eligible incarcerated individuals and their families the opportunity to meet for an extended period of time in a residential setting.

sponsored.t: Requires school districts to have diversity, equity and inclusion officers
sponsored.sum: Requires school districts to have diversity, equity and inclusion officers to develop methods to diversify the personnel of the school district and to recommend changes to district policies and practices to reduce racial disparities in hiring school district employees, particularly teachers; requires boards of education to annually report information regarding such policies and practices to the department of education; requires the department of education to annually report such information to the legislature.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring the state board of parole to reflect the composition of the prison population in race, age and geographic area of residence
sponsored.sum: Alters the composition of the state board of parole to include members who shall adequately reflect the composition of the prison population in race, age, and geographic area of residence.

sponsored.t: Expands the Doctors Across New York program to include dentists
sponsored.sum: Expands the Doctors Across New York program to include dentists.
sponsored.fis: None. Existing funds would be re-allocated.

sponsored.t: Relates to controlled substances and indeterminate sentences; to the expansion of merit time; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to controlled substances and indeterminate sentences; relates to the expansion of merit time; repeals provisions relating to the allowance of limited credit time for incarcerated individuals.
sponsored.fis: The bill will result in savings to the state because the early release of inmates who earn merit time will result in a continued decline in the prison population.

sponsored.t: Relates to bulk purchases of firearms or ammunition and review by the state police
sponsored.sum: Directs the state police to promulgate any necessary rules and regulations regarding the flagging for further review of bulk purchases of firearms or ammunition.

sponsored.t: Relates to deeming individuals facing criminal charges as being incapable of consent when the actor is a law enforcement agent who knows or should know that such person is facing pending charges
sponsored.sum: Deems individuals facing criminal charges as being incapable of consent when the actor is a police officer, peace officer or other law enforcement agent who knows or reasonably should know that such person is facing pending charges unless such person is a member of the same family or household as such police officer, peace officer or other law enforcement agent.

sponsored.t: Establishes a joint legislative committee on racial equity in New York state
sponsored.sum: Establishes a joint legislative committee on racial equity in New York state to review and prepare a racial equity impact assessment on all legislation that is reported favorably to both houses of the legislature.

sponsored.t: Relates to parole eligibility for crimes committed at age twenty-one or younger
sponsored.sum: Relates to parole eligibility for crimes committed at age twenty-one or younger; provides if such individual is convicted of a crime prior to their twenty-second birthday for which they were sentenced to a period of incarceration greater than 20 years, they shall be eligible for parole after fifteen years of incarceration.

sponsored.t: Relates to cannabinoid hemp retail sales and retailers
sponsored.sum: Relates to cannabinoid hemp retail sales and retailers; makes technical changes to the definition of THC; provides specific requirements for labeling of cannabinoid hemp products.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing home confinement for certain prisoners during a declared state of emergency
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the commissioner to place certain incarcerated individuals in home confinement during a declared state of emergency if such state of emergency conditions materially affect the functioning of the department of corrections and community supervision.
sponsored.fis: : Will save the state money by lowering the prison population and lowering medical costs for incarcerated people.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring the release of body camera recordings in instances where an officer uses force within thirty days of such incident
sponsored.sum: Requires the release of body camera recordings in instances where an officer fires a gun and hits someone or could have caused injury, uses a stun gun, or makes use of any other force that causes harm within thirty days of such incident.

sponsored.t: Requires that a defendant must be over twenty-five years old to be guilty of felony murder
sponsored.sum: Requires that a defendant must be over twenty-five years old to be guilty of felony murder.

sponsored.t: Ends the imposition of a sentence of life without parole or death; repealer
sponsored.sum: Ends the imposition of a sentence of life without parole and the death penalty.
sponsored.fis: : TBD. This legislation has the potential to save the state money when individuals are released.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale of a firearm, rifle, shotgun or ammunition on state property
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale of a firearm, rifle, shotgun or ammunition on state property including state and county fairgrounds, and county, city and municipal property; designates offense as a class A misdemeanor.
sponsored.fis: : There could be a minimal but acceptable loss of revenue from prohibiting gun shows on state property and the state fairgrounds.

sponsored.t: Relates to public health emergency allowances against sentences for certain incarcerated individuals
sponsored.sum: Relates to public health emergency allowances against sentences for certain incarcerated individuals; allows up to twelve months of public health emergency allowances to be given to incarcerated individuals during a public health crisis.
sponsored.fis: : Will save the state money by lowering the prison population and lowering medical costs for incarcerated people.

sponsored.t: Prohibits children twelve years old and younger from playing tackle football
sponsored.sum: Prohibits children twelve years old and younger from playing tackle football.

sponsored.t: Requires employers to make a conditional offer of employment before inquiring about any criminal convictions of a prospective employee
sponsored.sum: Relates to unlawful discriminatory practices; requires employers to make a conditional offer of employment before inquiring about any criminal convictions of a prospective employee.
sponsored.fis: Successful re-entry and re-integration of formerly incarcerated individ- uals will increase state revenues through the inclusion of thousands of able-bodied, "taxpaying citizens" to the state's workforce; additional savings to the state will ensure from a reduction in costs associated with recidivism, re-incarceration and social services.

sponsored.t: Prohibits corrections employees from participating in degrading behavior towards incarcerated persons or fellow employees
sponsored.sum: Prohibits corrections employees from participating in degrading behavior towards incarcerated persons or fellow employees; establishes any individual who participates in such behavior shall be disciplined by the department and may have their employment terminated for cause.

sponsored.t: Includes within the class A misdemeanor of criminal possession of a weapon in the fourth degree, the possession of a weapon, outside the home, while intoxicated; repealer
sponsored.sum: Includes within the class A misdemeanor of criminal possession of a weapon in the fourth degree, the possession of a firearm, rifle or shotgun, outside the home, while impaired or intoxicated by use of alcohol or drugs; increases maximum fine for such offense to $10,000; provides for chemical testing of certain persons for whom there is reasonable cause to believe are in violation of such provision; provides for revocation of firearms permit upon conviction or refusal of a chemical test.
sponsored.fis: This legislation will not impose new costs on the State of New York.

sponsored.t: Requires certain eligible persons or entities to acquire and possess opioid antagonists
sponsored.sum: Requires certain eligible persons or entities to acquire and possess opioid antagonists for emergency treatment of a person appearing to experience an opioid-related overdose.

sponsored.t: Relates to membership warehouse stores
sponsored.sum: Prohibits membership warehouse stores from selling to a retailer.

sponsored.t: Relates to accessibility requirements in certain procurement contracts
sponsored.sum: Relates to accessibility requirements in certain procurement contracts; requires contracts that include information and communication technologies (ICTs) are accessible to people with disabilities; requires that the ability of a prospective contractor to meet such requirement be considered in making the contract award.

sponsored.t: Requires insurance policies to provide coverage for medically necessary hearing aids purchased from hearing aid dispensers
sponsored.sum: Requires insurance policies to provide coverage for medically necessary hearing aids purchased from hearing aid dispensers.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York student loan assistance and home purchase act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "New York student loan assistance and home purchase act" for the purposes of facilitating the purchase of homes by individuals who are burdened by student debt, by providing financing opportunities for the consolidation of student debt into a mortgage.

sponsored.t: Relates to the "juvenile offender second chance act"
sponsored.sum: Relates to the "juvenile offender second chance act" which establishes the ability for a person to be adjudicated to be a youthful offender and receive all provisions and benefits of being a youthful offender.

sponsored.t: Relates to permitting a qualified incarcerated individual eligible for early release to receive a conditional release
sponsored.sum: Relates to permitting an incarcerated individual who has had a final order of deportation issued against such incarcerated individual, has not been convicted of an A-1 felony and who is eligible for early release to receive a conditional release.
sponsored.fis: It will save the state money by allowing foreign incarcerated individ- uals to be released from their terms of incarceration six months sooner.

sponsored.t: Repeals provisions of the executive law relating to probation and prohibits certain fees relating thereto
sponsored.sum: Relates to probation administrative fees; prohibits certain fees associated with probation; provides for the termination and discharge of certain sentences.

sponsored.t: Includes the city of New York in the aid and incentives for municipalities program
sponsored.sum: Includes the city of New York in the aid and incentives for municipalities program for fiscal years beginning 4/1/2025 and thereafter.

sponsored.t: Provides excelsior scholarships for low-income law students
sponsored.sum: Allows students enrolled in public juris doctor or master of laws programs to apply for excelsior scholarships.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of a sex offense
sponsored.sum: Relates to the definition of a sex offense; provides that if luring a child or the attempt thereto requires an actor to register as a sex offender, then the act is determined to be a sex offense.

sponsored.t: Relates to rental assistance for New York city charter school students; metered in funding
sponsored.sum: Relates to metered in funding for rental assistance for all New York city charter students.
sponsored.fis: There would be fiscal implication for local government related to this bill.

sponsored.t: Relates to access to prescription drugs for chronic weight management
sponsored.sum: Requires managed care providers and the medical assistance program shall cover prescription drugs approved by the federal food and drug administration for chronic weight management in adults with obesity with at least one weight-related condition.

sponsored.t: Relates to audits conducted by the office of Medicaid inspector general detecting ministerial or clerical errors that generate an overpayment
sponsored.sum: Relates to audits conducted by the office of Medicaid inspector general detecting ministerial or clerical errors that generate an overpayment to a vendor providing non-emergency medical transportation services.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing electronic mail services to an incarcerated individual
sponsored.sum: Provides electronic mail services to an incarcerated individual which allows an incarcerated individual to send up to ten electronic mail letters a day at no charge.

sponsored.t: Establishes an electric scooter operator's safety manual, licensing requirement and insurance requirement
